subject: andean bear
title: South America's Only Bear Builds Platforms in the Trees

scenes.text: South America has just one kind of bear, and it builds furniture in the trees.
The Andean bear lives in the cloud forests of the Andes, and big males top one hundred fifty kilos.
It climbs high, then bends and breaks branches into a platform.
Up there it can reach fruit high in the canopy, and it sleeps on the same platform.
After the giant panda, it's probably the most plant-eating bear alive. It loves bromeliads.
And no two have the same face. Each bear's pale spectacle markings are unique.

description:
The Andean, or spectacled, bear is South America's only bear. It builds platforms in trees to reach fruit and to sleep.
It is probably the most herbivorous bear after the giant panda, and the pale markings around its eyes are unique to each bear.
Which bear should we cover next?
first_comment: Andean bears don't hibernate. Which would you rather meet in the woods, this bear or a grizzly?
